BeyondTheBricksiPad · Preparing for release

See the bricks. Step inside.

Point your iPad at a finished physical brick set, open a portal and step inside the set to explore it. Built together by team ButterCoconut.

SupportPrivacy Policy ↗

INSIDE BEYONDTHEBRICKS

An adventure that starts from your finished set.

01

Step inside the bricks

Recognize a supported physical set and enter its experience through a portal. Requires iPadOS 27 or later and recognition data for the set.

02

View in 3D

Choose a brick model in Discover Sets and examine it from different angles.

03

Place models in AR

Place brick models in your surroundings. Camera permission and an AR-capable device are required.

Meet the team

BeyondTheBricks is a non-commercial fan project designed and developed by the four members of team ButterCoconut in Challenge 6 of the 2026 program at the Apple Developer Academy @ POSTECH.

Independent fan-made app

BeyondTheBricks is an independent fan-made app. It is not an official LEGO® product. LEGO® is a trademark of the LEGO Group of companies, which does not sponsor, authorize or endorse this app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by NASA. All other trademarks, characters and works the sets portray belong to their respective owners, who do not sponsor, authorize or endorse this app. See the in-app credits for sources and licenses.
